verdict.rationale: Serverless GPU endpoints are a fair question for a GPU cloud, but the evidence only shows Lambda shipping always-on VM instances, clusters, Managed Kubernetes, and Slurm, with no autoscaling serverless workers or scale-to-zero. Instances are billed by uptime, and a community report confirms that idle running instances are billed the same as in-use ones, which is the opposite of scale-to-zero.
